title: Corpse Explosion
problem: Damage = Int × Moderate (110%) × number of dead creatures. The text says "a small amount of damage, increased by the number of dead creatures". With nobody dead it deals 0.
notes: In-game test: Corpse Explosion with 0, 1 and 2 dead creatures: damage = Small potency x 1, x 2, x 3. Community claim: Damage is multiplied by the number of dead creatures. Evidence: bc_SpellDamage case L1678-L1684: count of hp <= 0 in creatureList, then (amount + Int × DMG_MODERATE) × count (multiply @0x14161925a). Fix sketch: T: "Enemies take a moderate amount of damage for each dead creature on the battlefield." Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Moderate damage x number of dead creatures (0 with none dead). 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "small amount of damage, increased by the number of dead creatures". Fix: H + user decision on the formula: text implies Small damage that grows with the dead count (not Moderate x count, which is 0 with nobody dead); proposed Small x (1 + dead count). vs bugged: stronger with 0 dead, weaker with many. User 2026-10-26: agreed the 0-dead case must deal damage; formula Small potency x (1 + dead creatures) (the text says 'small amount ... increased by the number of dead creatures'). User 2026-10-26: formula approved.

release_notes.intended: Enemies take a small amount of damage, increased by the number of dead creatures.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the damage was a moderate amount times the number of dead creatures, so it dealt nothing when nobody was dead.
release_notes.fix: Now it deals a small amount times (1 + the number of dead creatures).
